items.title: AI companies just signed a White House accord, and tech folks can't get enough of the signatures
items.summary: Users on X locked in on the signatures of top tech executives on a White House AI "constitution."

items.title: Alphabet shares up in premarket trade after Gemini 4 Argon launch
items.summary: Investing.com -- Alphabet Inc Class A (NASDAQ:GOOGL) shares rose about 2% in premarket trading on Thursday after Google launched a new artificial intelligence model, Gemini 4 Argon, touting stronger coding and cybersecurity performance than rival models at lower prices.

items.title: Dow Jones Futures: Micron Earnings Crush Views, S&P 500 At Critical Level As Treasury Yields Rise
items.summary: The Nasdaq faded while the S&P 500 fell to its 50-day as Treasury yields keep running. Micron earnings easily beat views.

items.title: VIG Cannot Own Meta’s or Alphabet’s Dividends Until 2035 at the Earliest: The 10-Year Rule Written Into Its Index
items.summary: VIG promises exposure to America's greatest dividend growers, but a single rule in its index methodology keeps two of the biggest new payers completely locked out for the next decade.

items.title: Google Unveils New AI Model Gemini 4 Argon, Sending Alphabet Stock Higher
items.summary: Google is rolling out the new model to a set of cybersecurity companies before making it available to developers, customers, and consumers at a later date.

items.title: Google Stock Rises On Gemini 4 Argon Release After New AI Model Delays
items.summary: Alphabet released its most powerful, artificial intelligence model called Gemini 4 Argon. Google stock climbed on the news.

items.title: Alphabet stock slips on report of internal doubts over Gemini 4
items.summary: Investing.com -- Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ:GOOGL) shares declined Wednesday heading to the market close, paring gains to up 0.5% from up over 2%, following a Bloomberg report that highlighted internal employee skepticism about the performance of the company’s upcoming Gemini 4 artificial intelligence model.

items.title: Was There Any Sign Palantir Stock Would Run?
items.summary: Palantir Technologies (PLTR) stock returned 60.3% in the three months from June 30 to September 29, 2026. A $10,000 holding at the start of that window was worth about $16,030 at the end. The run came from faster sales growth, led by the U.S. business, and Palantir reports that growth every quarter. Could you have seen that growth coming before June 30.
